source.author: verg
source.text: Ut pelagus tenuere rates, nec iam amplius ulla occurrit tellus, maria undique et undique caelum, olli caeruleus supra caput astitit imber, noctem hiememque ferens, et inhorruit unda tenebris.
source.text_original: Ut pelagus tenuere rates, nec iam amplius ulla / occurrit tellus, maria undique et undique caelum, / olli caeruleus supra caput astitit imber, / noctem hiememque ferens, et inhorruit unda tenebris.
source.text_english: When the ships had held the open sea, and no land now appeared any longer, on every side only sea and on every side sky, over their heads there stood a dark blue rain-cloud, bringing night and winter, and the wave bristled darkly.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Postquam me a tuo latere subitus turbo conuoluit, postquam glutino caritatis haerentem inpia distraxit auulsio, tunc mihi caeruleus supra caput astitit imber, tunc maria undique et undique caelum.
reuse.text_original: Postquam me a tuo latere subitus turbo conuoluit, postquam glutino caritatis haerentem inpia distraxit auulsio, tunc mihi caeruleus supra caput astitit imber, tunc maria undique et undique caelum.
reuse.text_english: After a sudden whirlwind hurled me away from your side, after that impious tearing apart dragged me away though I was clinging by the bond of love, then a dark blue rain stood above my head, then seas on every side and sky on every side.
